correctness.rationale: The proof uses only the printed vector fields and sliding formulas. At R0=1, beta=r1 and Ic0=0 exactly. The lower normal component is strictly negative for every positive Ic. The upper tangency coordinate simplifies to Sc2=r0 Ic/Delta+b r1/Delta. Comparing the printed sliding fixed point Ss=(Lambda-(mu+nu)Ic)/mu with Sc2 gives the exact necessary-and-sufficient cutoff. The sliding derivative is -mu<0, and the invariant-region bound is automatic. Exact rational replay verifies the explicit witness and field signs.

value.rationale: R0=1 is the epidemiological threshold separating the source major regimes, and pseudo-saddles organize its sliding bifurcations and global homoclinic structures. The printed equality condition removes every positive threshold by algebraic collapse, while the corrected criterion restores a whole physically admissible wedge and identifies its tangency boundary. This is a natural classification correction, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
